chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about the souls of the believers, and he said: “In paradise, in the forms of their bodies; if you were to see him, you would say: so-and-so.”

key_terms.أَبْدَانِهِمْ: their bodies, meaning forms corresponding to their bodily identities
key_terms.أَرْوَاحِ: the souls, referring here to the souls of the believers after death
key_terms.صُوَرِ: forms or likenesses, indicating recognizable appearance
key_terms.فُلَانٌ: so-and-so, indicating that the person would be recognizable by identity
key_terms.ٱلْجَنَّةِ: paradise, the blessed abode mentioned as their place

ai.seo_question: What do the souls of the believers look like in the afterlife according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the state of the souls of the believers after death, stating that they are in paradise in forms resembling their bodily forms. It indicates recognizability and continuity of identity in the afterlife.
